question: Fill in the blank:The Ladakhi New Year festival Losar features symbolic dough figures of ______, sun and moon kept inside homes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ibex**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Losar** is the traditional **New Year festival of Ladakh**, celebrated with much enthusiasm and cultural significance by the people of the region.
 
• During the festival, symbolic dough figures of the **ibex**, along with representations of the **sun and moon**, are crafted and placed in homes.
 
• The **ibex** is considered a sacred animal in Ladakhi culture, symbolizing strength, agility, and blessings. Its inclusion in the festival reflects its cultural and spiritual importance.
 
• The sun and moon figures represent cosmic harmony and the cyclical nature of time, aligning with the New Year celebrations and the hope for prosperity.
 
• The festival includes traditional rituals, dances, and offerings to deities, ensuring blessings for the upcoming year.
